title: NPCore: Core Loop
summary: Use NPC contacts as repeatable sources of guidance, exchange, and services.

blocks.title: The Loop
blocks.body: Find a contact, read the dialogue, choose the useful tab, pay the required cost, note cooldowns or stock, and return when the route or mission state changes.

blocks.title: Read The Result
blocks.body: A successful NPC action should update the status line, inventory, stock, cooldown, or dialogue node. If nothing changes, stop and check the requirement text.

blocks.title: Keep Contacts Useful
blocks.body: Treat contacts as local tools. A medic, archivist, scavenger, or technician is strongest when you remember what they provide and when they refresh.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
